text:
jamal: Heads up — terraform import race just hit us. dynamodb lock contention + backend drift. some of the eu gpu pool got created in us-east. noticed a big egress spike. anyone with context?
ben-infra: yep, two imports overlapped: the gitops pipeline and a manual rollback job. seems the S3 key was different for the manual run so state diverged. dynamodb TTL didn't renew during the second attempt.
deploy-bot: Notification: terraform import started by infra/rollback-pipeline#778
Command: terraform import module.gpu.aws_instance.pool[0] i-0abcd1234
Lock: acquired lock id lk-abc123
Note: jenkins-job-779 attempted to import and failed to acquire lock (timeout)
maria: are resources actually duplicated across regions or just state pointers? we need to know if charges are from cross-region traffic or duplicate VM billing.
ben-infra: both. some instances actually launched in us-east (wrong provider region) and are pulling images from eu registries -> heavy cross-region egress. plus we now have mismatched state refs.
olga: can we stop the us-east ones quickly? finance just pinged, cost alarm is +$12k in last 2 hours.
sam: do NOT run any apply. first step: acquire canonical lock on the canonical backend key and run "terraform state list" to get the truth. then plan reconcile.
ben-infra: plan: 1) force-lock safe check (ops confirmed no active runners) 2) terraform state pull > current.tfstate 3) identify misplaced resources with "terraform state list | grep module.gpu" 4) terraform state rm for the wrongly-imported ones in us-east 5) re-import into eu backend with correct backend-config and tags.
ben-infra: snippet: ```terraform init -backend-config="bucket=redwood-tfstate-prod" -backend-config="key=env/prod/gpu.tfstate" -backend-config="region=eu-west-1" -force-copy
terraform state pull > current.tfstate
# inspect then
terraform state rm module.gpu.aws_instance.pool[1]
terraform import -state=./current.tfstate module.gpu.aws_instance.pool[1] i-0correct```
tara: reminder — pipeline had TF_REGION exported in the rollback job. that env override caused terraform to init with us-east backend. we'll add a guard that rejects runs if TF_REGION is set.
ops-oncall: CI runners for pipeline#779 finished ~40m ago. i've killed any stale runners. safe to force-unlock after ben confirms no live terraform processes.
leo: i'll add a terraform-init precheck step in gitops that validates the backend key and region match git config (fail fast). also adding a lightweight lock-health webhook to alert early.
maria: filing a change to pin backend config in repo (no env overrides) + pre-merge lint. tagging infra and devex.
ben-infra: reducing us-east gpu autoscaling to 0 and draining instances to minimize egress while we reconcile. will run the state reconcile now (canary first). tagging @jamal when I start.
jamal: thanks. once reconcile done please post steps and runbook update. i'll coordinate a brief postmortem and cost estimate for finance. :thumbsup:
